title: TRICARE Prime Regular Installment Value for Amounts Kept After a First-Installment Duplicate
content:
**Schedule note.** When part of a duplicate payment on the first installment of a new fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment is kept on the account, a regular installment kept on the account is valued by the installment charge whose coverage period begins latest:

| Latest-beginning installment charge | Value of a regular installment |
|---|---|
| monthly | one twelfth of the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (divided by 12), rounded to the cent |
| quarterly | one quarter of it (divided by 4), rounded to the cent |
| otherwise | the whole annual fee |

Hypothetical TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B individual arrangement (annual fee 484.68): 40.39 monthly, 121.17 quarterly, 484.68 annual.
